summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal and returning True or False; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) with the title from the second item; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black) per instructions, so verification is by reading only. The ControlCode union is formatted one member per line. Nothing was committed.
